### [ 실습 ] Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis --- ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-812d-a03b-f194f55cc155/14d102cb05d2f6ea.webp)
1. Redis dependency 추가 - build.gradle ```bash ... dependencies { ... implementation 'org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-redis' } ```
2. Redis 설정 정보 추가 및 프로젝트 세팅 - RedisConfig ```java @Configuration public class RedisConfig { @Bean public RedisTemplate redisTemplate(RedisConnectionFactory connectionFactory) { RedisTemplate template = new RedisTemplate<>(); template.setConnectionFactory(connectionFactory); // 직렬화 설정 template.setKeySerializer(new StringRedisSerializer()); template.setValueSerializer(new GenericJackson2JsonRedisSerializer()); return template; } } ``` - AppController ```java @RestController public class AppController { @Autowired private RedisTemplate redisTemplate; @GetMapping("/") public String home() { redisTemplate.opsForValue().set("abc", "def"); return "Hello, World!"; } } ``` - Dockerfile ```docker FROM openjdk:17-jdk COPY build/libs/*SNAPSHOT.jar /app.jar ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app.jar"] ``` - application.yml ```yaml spring: datasource: url: jdbc:mysql://my-db:3306/mydb username: root password: pwd1234 driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver data: redis: host: localhost -> 이전 챕터와 동일한 오류 발생 port: 6379 ``` - compose.yml ```yaml services: my-server: build: . ports: - 8080:8080 depends_on: my-db: condition: service_healthy my-cache-server: condition: service_healthy my-db: image: mysql environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: pwd1234 MYSQL_DATABASE: mydb volumes: - ./mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql ports: - 3306:3306 healthcheck: test: [ "CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping" ] interval: 5s retries: 10 my-cache-server: image: redis ports: - 6379:6379 healthcheck: test: [ "CMD", "redis-cli", "ping" ] interval: 5s retries: 10 ```
3. 컨테이너 실행 ```bash ./gradlew clean build docker compose down docker compose up --build -d ``` - localhost:8080 호출 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-812d-a03b-f194f55cc155/65f0ec0a3ca39ccc.webp) - Connection refused 에러가 발생 → Redis 연결 실패 - application.yml ```yaml spring: datasource: url: jdbc:mysql://my-db:3306/mydb username: root password: pwd1234 driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver data: redis: host: localhost host: my-cache-server port: 6379 ``` 각 컨테이너는 각자의 네트워크를 가지고 있기 때문에, localhost가 아니라 Redis가 실행되고 있는 컨테이너로 통신을 해야 한다 따라서 localhost가 아닌 compose.yml에 정의한 service 이름으로 수정해야 한다. - host: localhost → my-cache-server ```bash ./gradlew clean build docker compose down docker compose up --build -d ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-812d-a03b-f194f55cc155/a0cfa8a3fd09fc87.webp) 컨테이너 재실행 시 , 위와 같이 오류없이 정상 실행되는 것을 확인할 수 있다. ```plaintext curl -X GET "http://localhost:8080" ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-812d-a03b-f194f55cc155/9140c2e90ae59f24.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/357e00e80429348449bcba14b5ab36c813c9d247/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-812d-a03b-f194f55cc155/bc9b1529aae06632.webp)
